description: Update policy for every repository of bulbashenko-com (infra docs/workflow.md, «Зависимости»). Repos extend it with github>bulbashenko-com/infra:renovate-preset.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Fixes for known vulnerabilities: their own PR, labelled security (a release of only these merges itself, docs/workflow.md), merged as soon as CI is green.

packageRules.description: Patch, minor, digest and pin updates: one PR that merges itself when CI is green. It lands on staging; production gets it with the next release.
0.x versions may break on a minor bump: treated as majors.
Major updates: all of them in one PR, kept current in place (a newer version replaces the older one in the same PR). Merged by hand, when convenient.
